reason: Hypothesis A proposes a specific, testable mechanism—annealing-driven precipitation of Mg-rich intermetallics that reduces micro-galvanic sites and promotes a uniform protective oxide—directly addressing the underexplored evolution–corrosion–oxidation link, with a clear baseline, intervention, and falsification.
